sql:
SELECT
    sum(SalesAmount) AS TotalLifetimeValue
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
WHERE CustomerKey IN (
    SELECT CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
    HAVING uniqExact(toYear(DateKey)) = (
        SELECT uniqExact(toYear(DateKey))
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    )
)
